title: There is no "save as" dialogua when using Zoomit screen recording

judgment.rationale: The supplied report confirms module state but does not distinguish recording completion failure from the save/trim dialog path or an option-specific capture failure.
evidence: PowerToys 0.101.2362 is installed from Microsoft Store and ZoomIt is enabled.
Ctrl+5 starts recording; the second Ctrl+5 removes the border without Save As or an output file.
The attached report's ZoomIt logs contain startup/enable entries but no capture, save, or failure event.
The report does not identify format, audio capture, or webcam-overlay settings.
judgment.recommended_action: Request the recording options, an isolation test with audio and webcam disabled, and a fresh report captured immediately after failure.

issue_context.summary: ZoomIt recording appears to stop, but no Save As dialog opens and no MP4 is found.
known_information: The affected version is 0.101.2362 on Windows build 26200.
ZoomIt is enabled and PowerToys is non-elevated.
The recording border disappears after the stop shortcut.
An existing diagnostic contains no recording/save failure entry.
inferences: The stop operation may have been reached, but successful finalization and entry into the save-dialog path are not established.
issue_context.analysis: Recording-path settings and immediate failure-time diagnostics are needed to locate the failing transition without repeating information already supplied.
initial_investigation: Reviewed the full issue and attached report metadata.
Reviewed ZoomIt's StartRecordingAsync and ShowSaveDialogWithTrim flow.
No confirmed duplicate or linked fix was found.

information_gaps.information: Recording format and microphone, system-audio, and webcam-overlay settings.
information_gaps.why_needed: Determines which capture and finalization path is active.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Reply with the selected format and enabled state of each option.

information_gaps.information: Whether Save As appears with audio capture and webcam overlay disabled.
information_gaps.why_needed: Separates a general save-flow problem from an option-specific failure.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Temporarily disable those options, retry once, and report the result.

information_gaps.information: A fresh diagnostic immediately after a failed recording.
information_gaps.why_needed: The existing archive does not contain the failing recording session.
information_gaps.how_to_collect: Immediately after reproducing, reply with `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP.

actions.label: Request ZoomIt recording-path evidence

comment.body: Thanks for the clear Ctrl+5 steps and the existing PowerToys report. It confirms ZoomIt is enabled, but the logs do not show whether recording finalization or the save/trim dialog path failed. Please confirm whether the recording format is MP4 or GIF and whether microphone audio, system audio, or the webcam overlay is enabled. Then temporarily disable audio capture and the webcam overlay, retry the same Ctrl+5 sequence once, and report whether Save As appears. Immediately after one new failed attempt, reply with `/bugreport` and attach the generated ZIP so it captures that session.
